rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality full-to-expanded blastocyst with compact ICM and cohesive TE, and appropriately notes uncertainty about 3 vs 4 expansion and limits of a static image. Minor speculative details (clock-face ICM location, small vacuoles/artifacts) prevent a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrial thickness, day of blastulation, prior cycle history, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is logical and internally consistent: strong morphology and favorable age/lining increase prognosis, while untested status and BMI temper expectations. Probability estimates are well supported.

Generally well aligned with Gardner grading concepts, eSET preference, luteal support, and cautious use of PGT-A at age 34. Minor deviations include some overinterpretation from a single image and broad statements about BMI/progesterone without cycle-specific context.

Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer and contingency planning, including eSET, luteal support review, alcohol cessation, prenatal care, and future male-factor workup. Useful, though not highly protocol-specific.
